rules.title: Required Disclosure Form Accompanying Notice to Quit for Nonpayment of Rent
rules.requirement: When a landlord gives a tenant a written notice to quit for nonpayment of rent, the notice must be accompanied by a state-developed form disclosing any repayment agreements, information on rental assistance programs and legal protections, and a prominent statement that the notice is not an eviction and the tenant is entitled to a court proceeding before being forced to leave. Courts may not accept an eviction filing for nonpayment of rent without proof this form was delivered to the tenant.

coverage_conditions.notes: Applies to residential dwelling unit evictions for nonpayment of rent only.

rules.penalty: Court may not accept the eviction filing (writ, summons or complaint) without proof of delivery of the required form.
rules.quoted_span: No court having jurisdiction over an action for summary process pursuant to chapter 239, including the Boston municipal court department, shall, in an eviction for nonpayment of rent for a residential dwelling unit, accept for filing a writ, summons or complaint without proof of delivery of the form required under this section.
rules.conflict_note: This section governs notice/disclosure procedure for nonpayment-of-rent evictions rather than establishing substantive just-cause grounds for eviction generally; Massachusetts does not have a general just-cause eviction requirement, so this record is included only because it is a mandatory eviction-notice protection within the 'notice' scope of this category.
